def solve(inp):
    h,w=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    cells={(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if inp[r][c]==8}
    res=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    def orients(cells):  # try L-tromino at a cell set
        pass
    ORI={('U','L'):2,('L','D'):3,('U','R'):4,('D','R'):5}
    def Ls_at(r,c):
        out=[]
        for a,b in [('U','L'),('L','D'),('U','R'),('D','R')]:
            m={'U':(r-1,c),'D':(r+1,c),'L':(r,c-1),'R':(r,c+1)}
            s=[(r,c),m[a],m[b]]
            if all(p in cells for p in s[1:]): out.append((s,ORI[(a,b)]))
        return out
    def sq_at(r,c):
        s=[(r,c),(r,c+1),(r+1,c),(r+1,c+1)]
        return s if all(p in cells for p in s) else None
    order=sorted(cells)
    used=set(); placed=[]
    def bt():
        rem=[p for p in order if p not in used]
        if not rem: return True
        r,c=rem[0]
        s=sq_at(r,c)
        opts=[]
        if s: opts.append((s,1))
        opts+= [(s2,col) for s2,col in Ls_at(r,c)]
        for s2,col in opts:
            # L orientation: corner is the cell with both arms; for Ls_at, (r,c) is corner
            used.update(s2); placed.append((s2,col))
            if bt(): return True
            used.difference_update(s2); placed.pop()
        return False
    assert bt(), "no tiling"
    for s2,col in placed:
        for (r,c) in s2: res[r][c]=col
    return res
